scripts.reset: pnpm run clean && pnpm install && pnpm run db:generate
scripts.dev: pnpm kill:ports && pnpm with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run dev --filter=@zomlab/web
scripts.build: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run build
scripts.build:production: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run build:production
scripts.deploy: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo deploy --filter=@zomlab/web
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo deploy:production --filter=@zomlab/web
scripts.versions:upload: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo versions:upload --filter=@zomlab/web
scripts.versions:upload:production: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo versions:upload:production --filter=@zomlab/web
scripts.check:all: pnpm run lint:workflows && pnpm run lint && pnpm run deps:check && pnpm run deps:unused && pnpm run check-types && pnpm run test
scripts.cf:validate: pnpm exec turbo run cf:typegen:check cf:deploy:check cf:deploy:check:production --filter=@zomlab/web --force --concurrency=1
scripts.test: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec vitest run
scripts.test:turbo: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run kill:e2e-port && env -u NO_COLOR pnpm exec playwright test
scripts.db:generate: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:generate --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:migrate --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:push: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:push --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:pull: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:pull --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:export: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:export --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:check: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:check --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:up: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:up --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.db:studio: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec turbo run db:studio --filter=@zomlab/database
scripts.deps:unused: pnpm run with-env -- pnpm exec knip
scripts.clean: pnpm exec rimraf node_modules .pnpm-store .turbo dist test-results apps/*/{node_modules,.turbo,dist,.output,.wrangler,storybook-static} packages/*/{node_modules,.turbo,dist,.output,.wrangler,storybook-static}
